incidents-bot: [pager] ⚠️ Billing/metering anomaly detected for emitter 'ingest-prod' — token-count delta +42% vs rolling baseline in last 15m. AlertID=ALRT-6109. Auto-escalate to on-call.
jamie: oncall here, looking now. paging eng-sre, billing.
sarah: seeing duplicate acks in consumer logs and a small replay queue spike. working to correlate deploys.
miguel: billing dashboard shows automated overage flags firing for ~12 customers in last 20m. @elaine can you confirm customer impact?
elaine: confirmed — ~12 customers got overage emails. pausing notification job now for env=prod. Also holding any automated account actions.
jamie: immediate mitigation plan: 1) disable duplicate-emitter path, 2) put metering pipeline into shadow mode for 10m, 3) pause billing notifications. executing step 1 now.
liz: running hotfix:
```
kubectl scale deployment emitter-dup -n prod --replicas=0
kubectl rollout restart deploy/emitter-consumer -n prod
```
I'll watch logs.
jamie: thanks liz — let us know when rollout finishes.
query-bot: quick query result for context:
```
-- tokens in last 60m
select sum(token_count) from metering.tokens where service='ingest' and ts > now() - interval '60 minutes';
-- result: 1.42x baseline (spike at 09:12)
```
sarah: root cause signal: idempotency key TTL expired after last deploy at 09:12, consumer accepted duplicates during a small window. likely race in idempotency refresh code.
miguel: rolling back the deploy that touched idempotency logic (commit e0f3a -> e0d9c). starting rollback now.
jamie: rollback complete. monitoring aggregator metrics and billing counters.
ryan: replay backlog is draining, token emission rate normalizing (graphs trending back to baseline).
elaine: notifications are paused, billing team will manually reconcile. we'll remove overage flags and issue credits once counts are verified. emailing CSMs to coordinate outreach.
sarah: sample log snippet showing duplicate handling gap:
```
2026-03-17T09:12:34Z consumer=emitter-consumer id=abcd1234 idempotency_ttl=0 accepted=true
2026-03-17T09:12:35Z consumer=emitter-consumer id=abcd1234 accepted=true
```
jamie: incident severity set to Sev2. creating incident channel and runbook link: https://redwood/incident/6109876543
liz: post-incident action items (high level):
- increase idempotency TTL and add unit tests for refresh path
- add consumer-level dedupe guard
- add a console toggle to flip metering to shadow mode quickly
Assigning owners next.
jamie: I'll create the follow-up tickets and assign to @sarah (root cause), @liz (infra fix), @miguel (reconciliation), @elaine (billing credits).
miguel: reconciliation ETA: generating per-customer CSV and diff in ~2h, will post in incident channel.
elaine: billing will undo emailed overage flags and issue credits; customer email template drafted, awaiting ops review.
jamie: planning handoff to next oncall in 30m after monitoring window. will update incident doc and close pager once reconciliation is confirmed.
sarah: good catch folks, thanks for quick coordination :thumbsup:
incidents-bot: Note: incident page and timeline recorded. Remember to add postmortem notes and timeline events before closure."
